newsitem.title: GERMANY: WestLB ups Deutsche 97, 98 EPS forecasts.
newsitem.headline: WestLB ups Deutsche 97, 98 EPS forecasts.

text.p: Germany's WestLB said on Friday that it had raised its earnings per share estimates for Deutsche Bank AG for 1997 and 1998 and was keeping the stock as an "outperformer."
Banking analyst Stefan Ermisch said he raised his 1997 estimate to 5.10 marks from 4.95 marks and the 1998 estimate to 5.80 marks from 5.55 marks.
"We still believe Deutsche will continue to be the strongest bank," Ermisch said.
The bank had the best strategic outlook and the highest profit prospects of the German banks, Ermisch said.
The merger plans between Bavarian banks Bayerische Vereinsbank AG and Bayerische Hypotheken- und Wechsel-Bank AG had not altered Deutsche's position, he added.
